title: HOW TO #2: Escape a Flooded City
caption:
How to escape a flooded city 🌊🛶

The river broke the dam and the water is at your door. 10 problems, 10 fixes: sandbags, a pump, a raft from doors and 4 plastic barrels, a rope around a lamp post, rain water in a tarp, a car battery for light. You reach the hill road 2 kilometers away, dry, with water and light.

Which would you grab first: barrels, rope or tarp? Comment RAFT below. Tag the friend who never leaves home without a plan B. Follow @StickMindR8 for HOW TO #3!
